scenario: Enforce one shared domain cap across adapter instances
preconditions: Two adapters share one coordinator; global read capacity is one
procedure_reference: Hold one read admission and request another through the second adapter
expected_result: Second adapter is denied until first lease releases
notes: Same-process shared-object simulation; not cross-process evidence

scenario: Enforce tenant cap across adapter instances
preconditions: Tenant A read cap is one and two adapters share one coordinator
procedure_reference: Hold tenant A call then submit another tenant A call
expected_result: Second A admission is denied
notes: Another tenant may use free global capacity

scenario: Reclaim expired admission after owner loss
preconditions: Lease owner stops renewing and expiry time passes
expected_result: New lease is granted and fencing token increases
notes: Lease expiry does not terminate an already-running remote operation

scenario: Reject stale release or renewal
preconditions: New lease exists after old lease expiry
expected_result: Stale operation cannot affect the new lease
required_evidence: Old/new lease identity and active snapshot
notes: Downstream storage must enforce fencing for stale writes

scenario: Extend a current lease
preconditions: An active lease remains before expiry
expected_result: Lease stays current until renewed expiry
notes: Adapter currently does not run automatic heartbeat

scenario: Apply one shared token bucket across adapters
preconditions: Shared rate and burst are configured
procedure_reference: Consume burst token in adapter A then request from adapter B
expected_result: B receives rate-limit error with retry-after estimate
notes: Rate policy values are synthetic and not production recommendations

scenario: Refill tokens according to injected monotonic time
preconditions: Shared token bucket is empty
procedure_reference: Advance coordinator clock by token interval
expected_result: A subsequent request is admitted
notes: No wall-clock sleep required

scenario: Fail closed when lease expires during a provider call
preconditions: Provider callback outlives coordinator lease TTL
procedure_reference: Return from callback after lease expiry
expected_result: Adapter raises lease-lost error and marks outcome unknown
required_evidence: Callback result, lease state and exception
notes: Provider side effect may already have happened

scenario: Keep provider operation domains separate
preconditions: Read admission is full; write domain has capacity
expected_result: Write remains independently admissible
notes: Limits are per coordinator/domain

scenario: Share priority aging across adapter waiters
preconditions: Two adapters share coordinator and one slot is occupied
procedure_reference: Queue tasks with different priorities and release the slot
expected_result: Coordinator selects highest effective priority then FIFO
notes: Fairness is only within the shared coordinator object

scenario: Remove a cancelled waiter from shared queue
preconditions: A task waits in coordinator admission queue
expected_result: Waiter is removed and no lease is issued
notes: Cancellation is cooperative

scenario: Fail and remove waiter after admission timeout
preconditions: Global or tenant quota remains saturated
procedure_reference: Wait longer than configured acquisition timeout
expected_result: Bulkhead-full error returned and queue slot removed
notes: Local process and coordinator use monotonic timeout

scenario: Honor bounded admission wait for next token
preconditions: Rate bucket becomes empty but timeout permits refill
expected_result: Request waits until token refill or wait budget expires
notes: This is coordinator admission wait, not provider retry

scenario: Reject invalid global policy
preconditions: Unknown domains, zero capacity or invalid rate values supplied
expected_result: Invalid policy fails before Provider calls
notes: No actual production values proposed

scenario: Fail closed when coordinator cannot grant admission
preconditions: Coordinator implementation raises or denies access
expected_result: Provider callback is not invoked
notes: Failure-mode choice must be approved in production

scenario: Report shared lease and throttle counters
preconditions: Multiple adapters acquire, expire, release and rate-limit operations
expected_result: Counters agree with synthetic lease transitions
notes: No payload, credential or secret is exposed

scenario: Override provider errors when admission lease expires
preconditions: Provider callback throws while shared lease TTL elapses
procedure_reference: Run callback with both permanent and transient synthetic errors after clock expiry
expected_result: ProviderAdmissionLeaseLostError is raised once; no automatic retry occurs
required_evidence: Provider callback count, lease state and exception type
notes: Outcome may be unknown and must be reconciled with the original idempotency key

scenario: Fail closed before admission
preconditions: Coordinator service is unavailable before a request
procedure_reference: Attempt a Provider read through an Adapter
expected_result: Provider callback is not invoked and coordinator phase is reported
required_evidence: Coordinator error phase and callback count
notes: Fail-open bypass is unsupported

scenario: Reclaim an orphan reservation after a lost acquire response
preconditions: Coordinator creates a lease but the acquire response is lost
procedure_reference: Attempt admission then advance synthetic monotonic time beyond lease TTL
expected_result: Provider callback is not invoked; orphan lease is reclaimed after expiry
required_evidence: Reservation outcome flag active lease count and expired counter
notes: Reservation outcome unknown does not mean Provider side effect occurred

scenario: Do not report success when coordinator becomes unavailable in-flight
preconditions: Provider callback starts and coordinator is made unavailable before lease validation
expected_result: Adapter reports coordinator state unknown and does not retry
required_evidence: Callback count exception phase and retained lease
notes: The test toggles an in-process flag; it is not a network partition test

scenario: Fail closed when lease cannot be validated after Provider response
preconditions: One-shot validate failure is injected
expected_result: State-unknown error is raised and retry count remains one
required_evidence: Exception outcome_unknown and Provider callback count
notes: Reconcile using the original object key and backup ID

scenario: Handle coordinator release outage after Provider response
preconditions: One-shot release failure is injected
expected_result: State-unknown error is raised and the lease remains until TTL reclamation
required_evidence: Callback count active lease count and expired counter
notes: Do not blindly replay a completed or ambiguous operation

scenario: Admit new work after service recovery and expiry reclamation
preconditions: Coordinator availability is restored and any orphan lease TTL has elapsed
expected_result: Expired lease is reclaimed and a new admission succeeds
required_evidence: Availability state active count and expired counter
notes: No production recovery-storm evidence

scenario: Surface renew and snapshot control failures
preconditions: Fault injection targets renew and snapshot phases
expected_result: Explicit coordinator unavailable errors identify the failed phase
notes: Diagnostics unavailability is not evidence that no leases exist
